send: i=0; while [ "$(getprop sys.boot_completed)" != 1 ] && [ $i -lt 1500 ]; do sleep 3; i=$((i+3)); done; sleep 30; echo BOOTDONE=$(getprop sys.boot_completed) fp=$(getprop ro.system.build.fingerprint)

echo "UDATA crypto=$(getprop ro.crypto.state) part=$(getprop ro.boot.boot_part_uuid) users=$(su 0 pm list users | grep -c UserInfo) apps3=$(pm list packages -3 | wc -l)/$(pm list packages -3 | sort | sha256sum | cut -c1-12) wifi=$(su 0 cat /data/misc/apexdata/com.android.wifi/WifiConfigStore.xml 2>/dev/null | grep -c '<Network>') adbkeys=$(su 0 cat /data/misc/adb/adb_keys 2>/dev/null | grep -c .) media=$(su 0 find /data/media/0 -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)/$(su 0 du -sk /data/media/0 2>/dev/null | cut -f1) appdata=$(su 0 ls /data/data | wc -l) aid=$(settings get secure android_id | sha256sum | cut -c1-12) end"

wait: UDATA crypto=encrypted part=\S+ users=\d+ apps3=\S+ wifi=\d+ adbkeys=\d+ media=\S+ appdata=\d+ aid=\S+ end
